initialization.scope: Repeated six-calibration-source startup constraints; ordinary data stream remains separate; development excluded
initialization.rms_reduction: Sample-pooled squares of original evaluator FP32 window RMS values
initialization.accepted_zero_policy: Advance ordinary Adam moments/counters once even when accepted parameter displacement is zero
initialization.constraint_policy: Both original physical excess inequalities for each of six calibration windows
initialization.projection: Complete rank-aware CPU FP64 projection; every reconstructed row verified
initialization.normal_budget_definition: Total actual FP32 displacement from the original full projected trial
initialization.normal_progress: Maximum positive physical excess divided by its original squared limit
initialization.fallback: Original extended grid from unchanged before/proposal/projected vectors
initialization.fraction_semantics: Base projected fraction; accepted normal motion is reported separately

ledger_scope: Completed updates with validated teacher-cache and Adam checks; failed attempts excluded

corrected_anchor_policy.normal_budget_definition: Total actual FP32 correction from original full projected trial
corrected_anchor_policy.progress_definition: Maximum positive relative excess using unchanged squared limits
corrected_anchor_policy.fraction_semantics: Base projected fraction, plus separately reported accepted normal correction
